annotations.title: Get best-value coworking in a city

description: Use this when the user asks for the BEST, top or recommended coworking spaces or private offices in a city, in any language ("bestes Coworking in Hamburg", "mejor coworking en Barcelona", "best private office London"). Returns a "best value coworking in {city}" ranking: an ordered list of spaces balancing price-vs-market, amenity count and review rating, computed from a Bayesian-shrunk composite the gateway deliberately never exposes as a raw comparable number — only the ORDER is meaningful (1st, 2nd, 3rd…), never a percentage gap between positions. 🔴 This ranking is relative to OTHER SPACES IN THE SAME CITY ONLY: it can never be compared across cities, so never say a city "ranks better" than another based on this tool. Requires a city slug from list_coworking_locations or resolve_coworking_query. Returns an empty ranking (not an error) when the city has coworking spaces but too few priced ones to rank meaningfully yet.

city.description: City slug, e.g. 'berlin'. Lowercase, hyphenated, never a display name. Required — this ranking only exists per city.

limit.description: Maximum number of ranked spaces to return.

locale.description: Language for names and descriptions. Set from the user's language: 'de' for German, 'es' for Spanish, otherwise 'en'.

name: get_best_coworking

citation.description: Attribution for this data under its CC BY 4.0 licence.

accessed.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the data was served.

text.description: One-line attribution with a link to the source page.

hasReviewData.description: False when no space in this city has a third-party rating; every entry's `rating` will then be absent.

entryPrice.description: Cheapest price PER DESK PER MONTH, normalised across the space's plans (an office's rent divided by its desks). It is NOT a price any listing prints — never quote it as "from X" for the space; use get_coworking_space for the real published prices.

position.description: 1-based rank within this city. The only number here worth comparing between entries.

sampleSize.description: How many priced spaces in this city were eligible for ranking at all.

title: Get best-value coworking in a city
